notes.roguelike.monster.rat: Monster names, in capitals (the crypt's messages are all capitals); each goes into the A {monster} / THE {monster} lines.
notes.roguelike.monster.wraith: A ghost in a hooded robe.
notes.roguelike.monster.trap: What killed the hero when no monster did (KILLED BY A TRAP).
notes.roguelike.blade.runeblade: A sword carved with runes: the best blade in the crypt.
notes.roguelike.say.near: Shown on reaching the last (tenth) floor, where the Amulet lies.
notes.roguelike.say.sees: A monster has noticed the hero. {monster} is a monster's name.
notes.roguelike.say.blade: The hero picks up a better blade; {blade} is its name.
notes.roguelike.say.rusty: A blade picked up that is worse than the hero's.
notes.roguelike.hud.floor: The top-left HUD: the floor number and the hero's level (LV: level). The spaces part the two.
notes.roguelike.hud.hp: Hit points now / at most, then the blade's name.
notes.roguelike.hud.count: How many potions or scrolls the hero carries (x2).
notes.roguelike.hud.keys: Key help in a tiny font: {wait}, {potion} and {scroll} are key names (J, L, K): the keys that wait a turn, drink a potion, read a scroll. Two spaces part the three.
notes.roguelike.touch.wait: Touch buttons: wait a turn, drink a potion, read a scroll. One short word each.
notes.roguelike.over.killed: On the tombstone screen: {monster} is a monster's name.
notes.roguelike.over.amulet: The Amulet of Embers is what the hero came for.
notes.roguelike.rip: Rest in peace, on a tombstone: keep it short (a tombstone's few letters).
notes.roguelike.rip.lies: On the tombstone, over A WANDERER: here lies a wanderer (the hero). Tiny font, narrow stone.
notes.roguelike.rip.lv: The hero's level, on the tombstone.

brief: The roguelike slice: ten generated floors of a torch-lit crypt in the manner of Rogue and Mystery Dungeon. The hero (unnamed, a wanderer, the player's own) goes down for the Amulet of Embers, fighting rats, bats, slimes, goblins, skeletons and wraiths. Its messages are terse, in capitals, like an old dungeon crawler's log: address the hero as "you". Keep them short: four of them stack in the corner of a small screen.
